verdict.rationale: Zulip documents first-party organization export tools for moving freely between Zulip Cloud and self-hosted servers. The export can include public data plus private channel messages and DMs from members who consented. The evidence never states the export format is open, and export is organization-level and administrator-run, with private data gated on consent, rather than a self-serve personal export. Missing for 10: explicit open-format specification of the export, individual-user self-service export of all personal data, independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Zulip has high quality export tools that can be used to migrate between the hosted Zulip Cloud service and your own servers.
You can move freely between Zulip Cloud hosting and your own servers with our high quality export and import tools.

Public and private data (with consent): Everything in the export of public data, plus all the private channel messages and direct messages that members who have allowed administrators to export their private data can access.
To import data from Slack, Mattermost, Rocket.Chat, Zulip Cloud, or another Zulip server, follow the linked instructions.
